name: jsontest-d8d6aef1f4/nullable-json-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.error lists only message
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: error:message
reason: The test asserts that field access on null JSON returns an error with detail message 'JSON value is not a mapping'. Its assertion requires error.detail(), which is absent from both the supported lang.error methods and the langlib method-call allowlist. This essential unsupported operation makes the whole case a feature despite field access itself being supported.
test_design_notes: io:println is output instrumentation; the essential unsupported behavior is extracting the asserted error detail.
